findings.highlight: After twelve tries, I finally found a taxi
findings.evidenceJa: タクシーを止めること十二台目、ようやく受け入れてくれる運転手
findings.governingReading: The twelfth taxi Shirou stops finally accepts the destination.
findings.explanation: “After twelve tries” places success after twelve attempts, implying a thirteenth taxi.

findings.highlight: wanting to be dropped off in the outskirts
findings.evidenceJa: 郊外の森で降ろしてほしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks to be dropped at a forest in the suburbs.
findings.explanation: The English omits the forest from the alarming requested destination.

findings.highlight: I have no way to match the shadow
findings.evidenceJa: 打開策はなく
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no countermeasure or way to break the deadlock against the shadow.
findings.explanation: The English changes solving or overcoming the situation into matching the shadow, suggesting parity.

findings.highlight: What can I do to Sakura?
findings.evidenceJa: ああなってしまった桜相手にどうすればいい
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not know how to deal with Sakura after what she has become.
findings.explanation: The English can read as uncertainty over what action to perform on Sakura and omits her transformed condition.

findings.highlight: It’s been two hours since I entered the forest
findings.evidenceJa: 森に入ってから二時間強
findings.governingReading: More than two hours have passed since entering the forest.
findings.explanation: The English removes the excess beyond two hours.

findings.highlight: the scene Illya showed me
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤに見せてもらった風景
findings.governingReading: The landscape is one Illya let Shirou see through her own eyes.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the benefactive relation, though the later line restores the visual mechanism.

findings.highlight: standing there, just like I remembered
findings.evidenceJa: あの時の姿のまま聳えていた
findings.governingReading: The castle towers exactly as it appeared when Shirou saw it through Illya’s eyes.
findings.explanation: The English turns fidelity to the earlier vision into generic memory.

findings.highlight: there’s no watch anywhere
findings.evidenceJa: 城壁はおろか、城門にさえ見張りがいない
findings.governingReading: There are no guards even at the gate, let alone along the castle walls.
findings.explanation: The English removes the escalating wall-to-gate spatial detail.

findings.highlight: a window on the second floor would be good
findings.evidenceJa: 窓、それも二階から上がいい
findings.governingReading: A window on the second floor or above would be preferable for infiltration.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the range to the second floor.

findings.highlight: get in through the back door
findings.evidenceJa: 裏門から入ってやる
findings.governingReading: Shirou considers entering through the rear gate if necessary.
findings.explanation: The English changes a castle gate into an ordinary door.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s magical energy was like after the crest took control
findings.evidenceJa: 刻印に侵された桜の魔力
findings.governingReading: The mana belongs to Sakura while her body is invaded by the strange markings.
findings.explanation: The English makes one crest an agent that has already taken control, promoting interpretation into fact.

findings.highlight: It’s thicker on lower grounds
findings.evidenceJa: 下に行くほど濃くなってる
findings.governingReading: The magical energy grows denser the farther downward one goes.
findings.explanation: The English uses the unnatural “lower grounds,” suggesting terrain rather than floors within the castle.

findings.highlight: I have to go save her if she’s trapped somewhere in this castle
findings.evidenceJa: 桜と対決する前に助け出しておかなければ
findings.governingReading: If Illya is confined elsewhere, Shirou must rescue her before confronting Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English omits the required sequence relative to the confrontation.

findings.highlight: I come across a storeroom
findings.evidenceJa: 倉庫のような部屋に足を踏み入れた
findings.governingReading: Shirou steps into a storage-like room at the back of the fourth floor.
findings.explanation: The English changes entry into merely encountering it and promotes resemblance to identification.

findings.highlight: It must be storage
findings.evidenceJa: 物置なのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively wonders whether the stone room is a storage space.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his question into certainty.

findings.highlight: the room
findings.evidenceJa: 石造りの部屋
findings.governingReading: The room is built of stone and cluttered with junk.
findings.explanation: The English omits its material construction.

findings.highlight: Sella
findings.evidenceJa: もう一人の子にセラと呼ばれていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes the name because the other attendant called her Sella.
findings.explanation: The English supplies the name without its observed basis.

findings.highlight: Illya’s servant
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの世話係
findings.governingReading: Sella is identified as Illya’s caretaker or attendant.
findings.explanation: The English changes her caregiving role into generic servitude.

findings.highlight: Sella bows and leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 慇懃に礼をして立ち去るセラ
findings.governingReading: Sella departs after an elaborately polite or punctilious bow.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pointed formality of her manner.

findings.highlight: Sella talks without emotion
findings.evidenceJa: 淡々と語るセラ
findings.governingReading: Sella speaks evenly and matter-of-factly.
findings.explanation: The English overstates controlled delivery as absence of emotion.

findings.highlight: I freeze at the sight
findings.evidenceJa: 訊くべき言葉が固まってしまった
findings.governingReading: The words Shirou ought to ask freeze before he can speak them.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou himself freeze and omits the failed question.

findings.highlight: It’s not her attitude that bothers me
findings.evidenceJa: 息を呑むのは、セラの態度からじゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou catches his breath for a reason other than Sella’s attitude.
findings.explanation: The English changes a sudden bodily reaction into being bothered.

findings.highlight: it feels like they’re sisters
findings.evidenceJa: 姉妹か何かのように思えて仕方がない
findings.governingReading: He cannot shake the impression that Sella and Illya are sisters or something akin to that, despite their differences.
findings.explanation: The English drops the explicit uncertainty beyond literal sisterhood.

findings.highlight: You’re Illya’s servant, right?
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの世話係なんだろ
findings.governingReading: Shirou appeals to Sella’s role as Illya’s caretaker.
findings.explanation: The English again changes caregiving responsibility into servitude.

findings.highlight: How rude
findings.evidenceJa: 気安い方ですね、貴方は
findings.governingReading: Sella calls Shirou remarkably overfamiliar or presumptuous.
findings.explanation: The English broadens her precise rebuke into generic rudeness.

findings.highlight: she needs to be freed as quickly as possible
findings.evidenceJa: お嬢様は一刻も早く逃がさねばなりません
findings.governingReading: Illya must be gotten out or allowed to escape as soon as possible.
findings.explanation: The English changes urgent escape into release from captivity.

findings.highlight: A black dagger is fired at me
findings.evidenceJa: 黒塗りの短剣が、飛来した
findings.governingReading: A blackened dagger flies from the place Sella occupied.
findings.explanation: The English adds a firing mechanism and makes Shirou its explicit target.

findings.highlight: My legs give way
findings.evidenceJa: 足がよろける
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s footing staggers after the strike.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies instability toward collapse.

findings.highlight: Pain wracks my body
findings.evidenceJa: 激痛に目を眩ませながら
findings.governingReading: Intense pain dazzles or blinds Shirou as he retreats.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the effect from vision to the whole body.

findings.highlight: a white skull glowing in the dark
findings.evidenceJa: 闇に浮かぶ、白い髑髏面
findings.governingReading: A white skull mask appears to float in the darkness.
findings.explanation: The English changes floating to emitting light and drops that it is a mask.

findings.highlight: a dagger has pierced my chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸には深々と刺さった短剣
findings.governingReading: The dagger is lodged deep in Shirou’s chest.
findings.explanation: The English omits the depth and embedded state.

findings.highlight: I am not like the magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師殿とは違う
findings.governingReading: The attacker contrasts himself with “the honored magus,” using a pointedly formal title.
findings.explanation: The English removes the sardonic honorific.

findings.highlight: when my hands are on the windowsill
findings.evidenceJa: 窓に手をかけたまま
findings.governingReading: Shirou still has one hand on the window when the blade crosses his neck.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the hand.
